hook: Salary Aate Hi Khatam Ho Jaati Hai?

points.title: 50% - Zaroorat
points.text: Rent, khana, bills, EMI. Jo kharche har mahine karne hi padte hain.

points.title: 30% - Shauk
points.text: Ghoomna, shopping, bahar khana. Enjoy karo, par is limit ke andar.

points.title: 20% - Bachat
points.text: Salary aate hi pehle ye side mein rakho. Emergency fund aur future goals ke liye.

takeaway: Pehle bachat, phir kharcha. Yahi 50-30-20 rule hai.
